-- 台账：存机场的对象句柄（机场被拆了句柄失效，就允许重新买）
ChoukaAirportUsed = ChoukaAirportUsed or {}

-- 自己的机场点位（airport1 ~ airport6），没有这个航点就返回 nil
function ChoukaAirportPoint(index)
    if type(exWaypointGetPos) ~= "function" then
        return nil
    end
    local wp = exWaypointGetPos(CHOUKA_AIRPORT_WP .. index)
    if wp == nil or wp[1] == nil then
        return nil
    end
    return wp[1], wp[2], wp[3]
end

-- 点位上已经有神州机场了吗？
--  ① 先看台账（自己买过的），② 再按类型在点位附近扫一遍结构（防止重进游戏/别人手放）
function ChoukaAirportExists(index, x, y, z)
    local used = ChoukaAirportUsed[index]
    if used ~= nil then
        if ObjectIsAlive(used) then
            return 1
        end
        ChoukaAirportUsed[index] = nil         -- 机场没了，点位腾出来
    end

    if type(ObjectFindObjects) ~= "function" then
        return 0
    end
    -- 按"类型名"扫（IncludeThing，照 DSA / 日冕 BUFF 的写法）
    if ChoukaAirportFilter == nil then
        ChoukaAirportFilter = CreateObjectFilter({
            Rule = "ANY",
            IncludeThing = { CHOUKA_AIRPORT_TYPE },
        })
    end
    local objs, count = ObjectFindObjects(nil, {
        X = x, Y = y, Z = z or 0,
        Radius = CHOUKA_AIRPORT_RADIUS,
        DistType = "CENTER_2D",
    }, ChoukaAirportFilter)
    if count ~= nil and count > 0 then
        for i = 1, count, 1 do
            local obj = objs[i]
            if obj ~= nil and ObjectIsAlive(obj) then
                ChoukaAirportUsed[index] = obj       -- 顺手记进台账
                _LOG(format("机场检查 玩家=Player_%d 点位上已有神州机场（扫到 %d 座），不能重复买",
                    index, count))
                return 1
            end
        end
    end
    return 0
end

-- 生成一座神州机场（照 DSA GiveFreeStructure__2.lua：CREATE_NAMED...+航点）
-- 先登记 ChoukaScriptCreated，免得被抽卡系统当成"原版结果"拦走
function ChoukaSpawnAirport(playerName, index, x, y, z)
    ChoukaAirportSerial = (ChoukaAirportSerial or 0) + 1
    local objName = format("ChoukaAirport_%d_%d", index, ChoukaAirportSerial)
    local nextId = GetNextObjectId()
    ChoukaScriptCreated[nextId] = 1

    ExecuteAction("CREATE_NAMED_ON_TEAM_AT_WAYPOINT_WITH_ORIENTATION",
        objName, CHOUKA_AIRPORT_TYPE,
        format("%s/team%s", playerName, playerName),
        CHOUKA_AIRPORT_WP .. index, CHOUKA_AIRPORT_ANGLE)

    local obj = GetObjectByScriptName(objName)
    if ObjectIsAlive(obj) then
        local actualId = ObjectGetId(obj)
        if actualId ~= nextId then
            ChoukaScriptCreated[nextId] = nil
            ChoukaScriptCreated[actualId] = 1
        end
        return obj
    end
    ChoukaScriptCreated[nextId] = nil

    -- 航点方式失败就退回 exCreateObject（和防御塔同一套兜底）
    if type(exCreateObject) == "function" then
        local id2 = exCreateObject({
            ObjectType = FastHash(CHOUKA_AIRPORT_TYPE),
            TeamName   = format("%s/team%s", playerName, playerName),
            Position   = { X = x, Y = y, Z = z },
            Angle      = CHOUKA_AIRPORT_ANGLE,
        })
        if id2 ~= nil then
            ChoukaScriptCreated[id2] = 1
            local obj2 = GetObjectById(id2)
            if ObjectIsAlive(obj2) then
                return obj2
            end
            ChoukaScriptCreated[id2] = nil
        end
    end
    return nil
end

function ChoukaDoBuyAirport(playerName)
    local index = ChoukaPlayerIndexFromName(playerName)
    if index == nil then
        return 0
    end

    local x, y, z = ChoukaAirportPoint(index)
    if x == nil then
        exAddTextToPublicBoardForPlayer(playerName, ChoukaT.airportNoPoint, 6)
        return 0
    end

    if ChoukaAirportExists(index, x, y, z) == 1 then
        exAddTextToPublicBoardForPlayer(playerName, ChoukaT.airportExists, 6)
        return 0
    end

    local price = CHOUKA_AIRPORT_PRICE
    local money = exPlayerGetCurrentMoney(playerName) or 0
    if money < price then
        exAddTextToPublicBoardForPlayer(playerName,
            format(ChoukaT.airportNoMoney, price), 6)
        return 0
    end

    local previous = SetWorldBuilderThisPlayer(1)
    ExecuteAction("PLAYER_GIVE_MONEY", playerName, -price)
    local building = ChoukaSpawnAirport(playerName, index, x, y, z)
    if building == nil then
        ExecuteAction("PLAYER_GIVE_MONEY", playerName, price)   -- 生成失败就退款
        SetWorldBuilderThisPlayer(previous)
        exAddTextToPublicBoardForPlayer(playerName, ChoukaT.airportSpawnFail, 6)
        return 0
    end

    -- 和防御塔一样收尾：免冷冻 + 购买当帧就是"已建成"（不等建造动画）
    ExecuteAction("UNIT_CHANGE_OBJECT_STATUS", building, "IN_SHIELD_SPHERE", 1)
    ExecuteAction("UNIT_CHANGE_OBJECT_STATUS", building, "UNPACKING", 0)
    ChoukaAirportUsed[index] = building
    SetWorldBuilderThisPlayer(previous)

    exAddTextToPublicBoardForPlayer(playerName,
        format(ChoukaT.airportBought, price), 6)
    return 1
end

    return 0

    return

-- ---------------- 小工具 ----------------

-- "Player_N" 这种名字 = 玩家座位（1~6）
function ChoukaAIIsSlotName(name)
    if name == nil or type(strsub) ~= "function" then
        return 0
    end
    if strsub(name, 1, 7) ~= "Player_" then
        return 0
    end
    local index = tonumber(strsub(name, 8))
    if index ~= nil and index >= 1 and index <= 6 then
        return 1
    end
    return 0
end

-- 自动升级线：第 5/10/15/20 回合后的等级（电脑只走这条线）
function ChoukaAutoLevelForRound(round)
    local level = 1
    if round ~= nil and ChoukaAutoLevelRound ~= nil then
        for lv, atRound in ChoukaAutoLevelRound do
            if round >= atRound and level < lv then
                level = lv
            end
        end
    end
    return level
end

-- 探测一次"AI"人格参数是否可用（只做一次）
if ChoukaAIAIProbeWorks == nil and type(EvaluateCondition) == "function" then
    ChoukaAIAIProbeWorks = 0
    for i = 1, 6, 1 do
        if EvaluateCondition("PLAYER_IS_HUMAN_OR_AI_PERSONALITY", "Player_" .. i, "AI") then
            ChoukaAIAIProbeWorks = 1
        end
    end
    if CHOUKA_AI_DEBUG == 1 and ChoukaAIAIProbeWorks == 0 then
        _ALERT(ChoukaT.aiPersona)
    end
end

-- 详见 docs/10-Lua注释存档.md §17_ai-2
function ChoukaAIIsComputer(index)
    if CHOUKA_AI_SLOTS ~= nil then
        if CHOUKA_AI_SLOTS[index] == 1 then
            return 1
        end
        return 0
    end

    local cached = ChoukaAIIsComputerCache[index]
    if cached ~= nil then
        return cached
    end

    if type(EvaluateCondition) ~= "function" then
        return 0
    end

    local name = "Player_" .. index
    if EvaluateCondition("PLAYER_IS_HUMAN_OR_AI_PERSONALITY", name, "Human") then
        ChoukaAIIsComputerCache[index] = 0
        return 0
    end

    local verdict = 0
    if EvaluateCondition("PLAYER_IS_HUMAN_OR_AI_PERSONALITY", name, "AI") then
        verdict = 1
    elseif ChoukaAIAIProbeWorks ~= 1 then
        -- "AI" 参数不被支持：把"非人类 + 有起重机 + 有钱"当成电脑
        local crane = GetObjectByScriptName("crane" .. index)
        local money = nil
        if type(exPlayerGetCurrentMoney) == "function" then
            money = exPlayerGetCurrentMoney(name)
        end
        if ObjectIsAlive(crane) and money ~= nil then
            verdict = 1
        end
    end

    ChoukaAIIsComputerCache[index] = verdict
    if verdict == 1 and CHOUKA_AI_DEBUG == 1 and ChoukaAIReportedAI[index] ~= 1 then
        ChoukaAIReportedAI[index] = 1
        _ALERT(format(ChoukaT.aiDetected, index))
    end
    return verdict
end

-- ---------------- ① 电脑每回合免费抽 1 个单位 ----------------

function ChoukaAIStartPos(index)
    local wp = exWaypointGetPos("Player_" .. index .. "_Start")
    if wp ~= nil and wp[1] ~= nil then
        return wp[1], wp[2], wp[3]
    end
    local crane = GetObjectByScriptName("crane" .. index)
    if ObjectIsAlive(crane) then
        return ObjectGetPosition(crane)
    end
    return nil
end

function ChoukaAIDrawOne(index)
    if type(ChoukaSpawnUnit) ~= "function" then
        return 0
    end
    local x, y, z = ChoukaAIStartPos(index)
    if x == nil then
        return 0
    end

    local playerName = "Player_" .. index
    -- 电脑的落点是自家出生点（陆地），按同一个判定入口问一次
    local onWater = 0
    if type(ChoukaTerrainAt) == "function" then
        onWater = ChoukaTerrainAt(x, y)
    end
    local level = ChoukaAutoLevelForRound(CHOUKA_ROUND)

    ChoukaAIDrawSerial = ChoukaAIDrawSerial + 1
    local slot = mod(ChoukaAIDrawSerial, 6) + 1
    local unit = ChoukaSpawnUnit(playerName, x, y, z, onWater, slot, 6, level)
    if unit ~= nil then
        -- 记一行坐标：万一"某人家门口多一个"，一眼能看出是不是电脑抽卡刷到了人类座位上
        if CHOUKA_DRAW_LOG == 1 then
            _LOG(format("AI抽卡 玩家=%s 位置=(%.0f,%.0f,%.0f) 水陆=%d Lv.%d",
                playerName, x, y, z or 0, onWater, level))
        end
        return 1
    end
    return 0
end

-- 每回合每个电脑抽几个：初始 1 个，每 5 回合 +1 个（上限 CHOUKA_AI_DRAW_MAX）
--   回合 0~4 → 1 个；5~9 → 2 个；10~14 → 3 个；15~19 → 4 个；20+ → 5 个
function ChoukaAIDrawCount(round)
    local count = CHOUKA_AI_DRAW_BASE
    if round ~= nil and round > 0 then
        count = CHOUKA_AI_DRAW_BASE + floor(round / CHOUKA_AI_DRAW_STEP)
    end
    if count > CHOUKA_AI_DRAW_MAX then
        count = CHOUKA_AI_DRAW_MAX
    end
    if count < 0 then
        count = 0
    end
    return count
end

-- 给一个电脑座位抽 n 个（每次都独立掷点数，所以这 n 个各是随机的）
function ChoukaAIDrawMany(index, count)
    local drawn = 0
    for k = 1, count, 1 do
        drawn = drawn + ChoukaAIDrawOne(index)
    end
    return drawn
end

local aiRoundChanged = (CHOUKA_ROUND ~= nil and ChoukaAILastRound ~= CHOUKA_ROUND)

if CHOUKA_AI_AUTO_DRAW == 1 and aiRoundChanged then
    ChoukaAILastRound = CHOUKA_ROUND
    local perSeat = ChoukaAIDrawCount(CHOUKA_ROUND)
    local drawnCount = 0
    for i = 1, 6, 1 do
        if ChoukaAIIsComputer(i) == 1 then
            drawnCount = drawnCount + ChoukaAIDrawMany(i, perSeat)
        end
    end
    if drawnCount > 0 and CHOUKA_AI_DEBUG == 1 then
        _ALERT(format(ChoukaT.aiDrawInfo,
            CHOUKA_ROUND, perSeat, drawnCount, ChoukaAutoLevelForRound(CHOUKA_ROUND)))
    end
end

-- ---------------- ② AI 攻击队列（照 DSA PureDrawJoinAIAttackTeam） ----------------

-- 扫"能选中的、非建筑"的东西；箱子和抽卡箱剔除
function ChoukaAIUnitFilter()
    if ChoukaAIUnitFilterCache == nil then
        ChoukaAIUnitFilterCache = CreateObjectFilter({
            Rule = "ANY",
            Include = "SELECTABLE",
            Exclude = "STRUCTURE",
            ExcludeThing = {
                "moneycrate",           -- 我们的钱箱
                "LuckyUnitCrateSeed",   -- 抽卡箱（点开就是抽卡）
                "UnitCrateNew", "UnitCrate", "MoneyCrateMP", "MoneyCrate", "ShroudCrate",
            },
        })
    end
    return ChoukaAIUnitFilterCache
end

-- 把一个对象塞进攻击队：<owner>/ATTACK
function ChoukaAIJoinAttackTeam(unit, ownerName, unitId)
    local attackTeam = ownerName .. "/ATTACK"
    if type(ObjectTeamName) == "function" then
        local currentTeam = ObjectTeamName(unit)
        if currentTeam == attackTeam then
            ChoukaAIJoinedIds[unitId] = 1
            return 0
        end
    end

    ExecuteAction("UNIT_SET_TEAM", unit, attackTeam)

    -- 可选：跟着自动等级给星（DSA 也会按 LEVELUP 补星，这里默认关）
    if CHOUKA_AI_NEUTRAL_LEVELUP == 1 then
        local level = ChoukaAutoLevelForRound(CHOUKA_ROUND)
        for i = 2, level, 1 do
            ExecuteAction("UNIT_GAIN_LEVEL", unit, 1)
        end
    end
    ChoukaAIJoinedIds[unitId] = 1
    return 1
end

-- 扫全场：非玩家阵营的单位 → 攻击队；电脑玩家的单位 → 可选攻击队
function ChoukaAIScanUnits()
    local c = exWaypointGetPos("center")
    if c == nil or c[1] == nil then
        return 0
    end
    local cz = c[3]
    if cz == nil then
        cz = 0
    end

    local units, count = ObjectFindObjects(nil, {
        X = c[1], Y = c[2], Z = cz,
        Radius = CHOUKA_AI_SCAN_RADIUS,
        DistType = "CENTER_2D",
    }, ChoukaAIUnitFilter())
    if count == nil or count <= 0 then
        return 0
    end

    local joined = 0
    for i = 1, count, 1 do
        local unit = units[i]
        if unit ~= nil and ObjectIsAlive(unit) then
            local unitId = ObjectGetId(unit)
            if ChoukaAIJoinedIds[unitId] == nil then
                local ownerName = ObjectPlayerScriptName(unit)
                if ownerName == nil then
                    ChoukaAIJoinedIds[unitId] = 1        -- 认不出归属的不碰
                elseif ChoukaAIIsSlotName(ownerName) == 0 then
                    -- 非玩家阵营（PlyrCivilian / PlyrCreeps / 其它中立）
                    if CHOUKA_AI_JOIN_NEUTRAL == 1 then
                        joined = joined + ChoukaAIJoinAttackTeam(unit, ownerName, unitId)
                    else
                        ChoukaAIJoinedIds[unitId] = 1
                    end
                else
                    -- 玩家座位：电脑的兵可选入队（一般不需要，引擎 AI 自己会打）
                    local slotIndex = tonumber(strsub(ownerName, 8))
                    if CHOUKA_AI_FORCE_PLAYER_ATTACK == 1 and slotIndex ~= nil
                        and ChoukaAIIsComputer(slotIndex) == 1 then
                        joined = joined + ChoukaAIJoinAttackTeam(unit, ownerName, unitId)
                    else
                        ChoukaAIJoinedIds[unitId] = 1
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return joined
end

ChoukaAIScanTick = ChoukaAIScanTick + 1
if CHOUKA_AI_JOIN_NEUTRAL == 1 or CHOUKA_AI_FORCE_PLAYER_ATTACK == 1 then
    if ChoukaAIScanTick == 1 or mod(ChoukaAIScanTick, CHOUKA_AI_SCAN_SECONDS) == 0 then
        local joinedCount = ChoukaAIScanUnits()
        if joinedCount > 0 and CHOUKA_AI_DEBUG == 1 then
            _ALERT(format(ChoukaT.aiAttackQueue, joinedCount))
        end
    end
end

-- ---------------- 逐玩家文字 ----------------

function ChoukaHudCreateTextForPlayer(playerName, index, y, color)
    if type(exCreateCustomTextForPlayer) ~= "function" then
        return 0
    end
    exCreateCustomTextForPlayer(playerName, {
        Index      = index,
        Content    = "",
        X          = CHOUKA_HUD_TEXT_X,
        Y          = y,
        Color      = color,
        Size       = CHOUKA_HUD_TEXT_SIZE,
        AlignX     = "left",
        AlignY     = "bottom",
        GroupIndex = 1,
    })
    if type(exCustomTextUpdateVisibilityForPlayer) == "function" then
        exCustomTextUpdateVisibilityForPlayer(playerName, index, 1)
    end
    return 1
end

function ChoukaHudUpdateText(playerName, index, text)
    if type(exCustomTextUpdateTextForPlayer) == "function" then
        exCustomTextUpdateTextForPlayer(playerName, index, text)
    end
end

function ChoukaHudCreateForPlayer(index)
    if ChoukaHudCreated[index] == 1 then
        return 1
    end
    if type(exCreateCustomTextForPlayer) ~= "function" then
        if ChoukaHudFailed[index] == nil then
            ChoukaHudFailed[index] = 1
            _LOG("HUD：没有 exCreateCustomTextForPlayer，左下角文字跳过（改用右上角计分板）")
        end
        return 0
    end
    local playerName = "Player_" .. index
    ChoukaHudCreateTextForPlayer(playerName, CHOUKA_HUD_ROUND_INDEX,     CHOUKA_HUD_ROUND_Y,     CHOUKA_HUD_ROUND_COLOR)
    ChoukaHudCreateTextForPlayer(playerName, CHOUKA_HUD_COUNTDOWN_INDEX, CHOUKA_HUD_COUNTDOWN_Y, CHOUKA_HUD_COUNTDOWN_COLOR)
    ChoukaHudCreateTextForPlayer(playerName, CHOUKA_HUD_LEVEL_INDEX,     CHOUKA_HUD_LEVEL_Y,     CHOUKA_HUD_LEVEL_COLOR)
    ChoukaHudCreateTextForPlayer(playerName, CHOUKA_HUD_PROB1_INDEX,     CHOUKA_HUD_PROB1_Y,     CHOUKA_HUD_PROB_COLOR)
    ChoukaHudCreated[index] = 1
    return 1
end

-- ---------------- 右上角计分板 ----------------

function ChoukaHudInitScoreBoard()
    if ChoukaHudScoreBoardReady == 1 then
        return
    end
    if type(exScoreBoardSetVisibility) ~= "function" or type(exScoreBoardSetText) ~= "function" then
        if ChoukaHudScoreBoardFailed == nil then
            ChoukaHudScoreBoardFailed = 1
            _LOG("HUD：没有计分板 API（exScoreBoardSetVisibility/exScoreBoardSetText），右上角信息跳过")
        end
        return
    end
    exScoreBoardSetVisibility(1)
    if type(exScoreBoardSetTitle) == "function" then
        exScoreBoardSetTitle(ChoukaT.hudTitle)
    end
    for i = 1, 6, 1 do
        exScoreBoardSetText(format("$p%dName:", i), i, 1)
        exScoreBoardSetText("  0", i, 2)
    end
    exScoreBoardSetText("回合", 7, 1)
    exScoreBoardSetText("0", 7, 2)
    exScoreBoardSetText("倒计时", 8, 1)
    exScoreBoardSetText("--:--", 8, 2)
    exScoreBoardSetText("抽卡等级", 9, 1)
    exScoreBoardSetText("Lv.1", 9, 2)
    exScoreBoardSetText("概率", 10, 1)
    exScoreBoardSetText("T1 100%", 10, 2)
    ChoukaHudScoreBoardReady = 1
    _LOG("HUD：右上角计分板已建立")
end

-- ---------------- 场上单位数（以 craneN 当本方锚点） ----------------

function ChoukaHudCountUnits(crane)
    if ChoukaHudUnitFilter == nil then
        ChoukaHudUnitFilter = CreateObjectFilter({
            Rule = "ANY",
            Relationship = "SAME_PLAYER",
            Include = "SELECTABLE",
            Exclude = "STRUCTURE",
            ExcludeThing = {
                "LuckyUnitCrateSeed",
                "UnitCrateNew",
                "UnitCrate",
                "moneycrate",
                "MoneyCrate",
            },
        })
    end
    local units, count = ObjectFindObjects(crane, nil, ChoukaHudUnitFilter)
    if count == nil then
        return 0
    end
    return count
end

-- ---------------- 每秒刷新 ----------------

ChoukaMarkNodeReady("HUD")
ChoukaHudInitScoreBoard()

-- 回合 / 倒计时数值（倒计时由 02_private_box.lua 每秒推进，这里只读）
local hudRound = CHOUKA_ROUND or 0
if CHOUKA_BOX_LEFT == nil then
    if CHOUKA_BOX_SECONDS ~= nil then
        CHOUKA_BOX_LEFT = CHOUKA_BOX_SECONDS
    else
        CHOUKA_BOX_LEFT = 120
    end
end
if CHOUKA_BOX_LEFT < 0 then
    CHOUKA_BOX_LEFT = 0
end
local hudRemainMinutes = floor(CHOUKA_BOX_LEFT / 60)
local hudRemainSeconds = CHOUKA_BOX_LEFT - hudRemainMinutes * 60

local hudLevel = ChoukaDrawLevel or 1
local hudWeights = nil
if ChoukaGetLevelWeights ~= nil then
    hudWeights = ChoukaGetLevelWeights(hudLevel)
end
if hudWeights == nil then
    hudWeights = ChoukaDrawTierWeights or { 100, 0, 0, 0, 0 }
end

local hudCountdownText = format("%02d:%02d", hudRemainMinutes, hudRemainSeconds)
local hudProbText = format("T1 %d%%  T2 %d%%  T3 %d%%  T4 %d%%  T5 %d%%",
    hudWeights[1] or 0, hudWeights[2] or 0, hudWeights[3] or 0,
    hudWeights[4] or 0, hudWeights[5] or 0)

-- ① 右上角：每人一行单位数 + 回合/倒计时/等级/概率
if ChoukaHudScoreBoardReady == 1 then
    for i = 1, 6, 1 do
        local crane = GetObjectByScriptName((ChoukaCranePrefix or "crane") .. i)
        local count = 0
        if ObjectIsAlive(crane) then
            count = ChoukaHudCountUnits(crane)
        end
        exScoreBoardSetText(format("  %d", count), i, 2)
    end
    exScoreBoardSetText(format("%d", hudRound), 7, 2)
    exScoreBoardSetText(hudCountdownText, 8, 2)
    exScoreBoardSetText(format("Lv.%d", hudLevel), 9, 2)
    exScoreBoardSetText(hudProbText, 10, 2)
end

-- ② 左下角：只给真人玩家画（AI 座位没有客户端）
for i = 1, 6, 1 do
    local isHuman = 0
    if type(EvaluateCondition) == "function" then
        if EvaluateCondition("PLAYER_IS_HUMAN_OR_AI_PERSONALITY", "Player_" .. i, "Human") then
            isHuman = 1
        end
    else
        isHuman = 1
    end
    if isHuman == 1 and ChoukaHudCreateForPlayer(i) == 1 then
        local playerName = "Player_" .. i
        ChoukaHudUpdateText(playerName, CHOUKA_HUD_ROUND_INDEX, format("回合数：%d", hudRound))
        ChoukaHudUpdateText(playerName, CHOUKA_HUD_COUNTDOWN_INDEX, ChoukaT.hudCountdown .. hudCountdownText)
        ChoukaHudUpdateText(playerName, CHOUKA_HUD_LEVEL_INDEX, format("抽卡等级：Lv.%d", hudLevel))
        ChoukaHudUpdateText(playerName, CHOUKA_HUD_PROB1_INDEX, hudProbText)
    end
end

ChoukaHudReady = 1
